Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func ScheduleSlots(start, end, duration int, busy [][2]int) ([]int, bool)
Behavior: Availability start/end, positive duration, and every half-open busy endpoint must be integers in 0..10,000,000. Reject start>end, interval start>end, or any addition beyond 10,000,000. Clip busy intervals to availability, stable-sort, and merge overlapping or touching intervals. Return duration-sized slot starts, stepping by duration in each free region.
Visible example: availability [0,10), duration 2, busy [3,5) returns starts [0,5,7].

Buggy source to repair:

package solution
func ScheduleSlots(int,int,int,[][2]int)([]int,bool){return nil,false}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
